name: Star Atlas
summary: A star chart 404 page: star 404 falls out of its constellation, and a wish sends a shooting star to your page
about: A full not-found page for a stargazing club, drawn as a printed star atlas on parchment in light mode and a glowing night sky over the Deosai plains in dark mode. Every constellation is a page of the site, from The Kite for star parties to The Camel for night trips, while star 404 falls out of The Page and leaves a dashed ring. Make a wish and a shooting star flies to the matching constellation, traces its lines and opens a plate with the link.
how: The chart fades in, the stars pop into place and star 404 falls out of the sky
Hover or tab to a constellation to see its lines; press it to trace it and open its plate
Type in Make a wish and press Wish; a shooting star flies to the right constellation
Wish for a page that has no constellation and star 404 is relit with it
Drag across the sky to throw shooting stars; trace all five for a meteor shower
It plays a short demo by itself until you click or type
